subject: Sorry, need to move our call
text: Sorry to drop this last minute, but our call tomorrow may need to shift by a few hours because something unexpectedly good happened with the old appliance I had given up on, the repair person says it can be saved with a simple part and will stop the noise by evening. I don’t want to keep you waiting while I wait to hear if the part really arrives, so if you could send a few possible slots, I’ll take the one that lets me call you back after lunch? I’m rushing between errands and the courier, but I don’t want you to think I’m forgetting or being careless. I really appreciate how easy you’ve been about these changes, and I’ll make sure to send a confirmation once we lock it down. If tomorrow is now terrible, say so, and I’ll take a later evening slot. I will confirm once settled.
